units.source_text: 那年阿雪十岁，刚上普通小学三年级。

en.t: That year Axue was ten years old and had just started third grade at an ordinary elementary school.
She walked to school each day with her little brother on her back.

units.source_text: 父亲他们的吃穿，一切都由她照拂。

en.t: She took care of everything for her father and the others, from food to clothing.

units.source_text: 她捡了一只野狗来喂养，这是她唯一的奢侈品。

en.t: She had picked up a stray dog and kept it, and that was her only luxury.

units.source_text: 她夜半出门要奶，狗忠实地跟在她后头。

en.t: When she went out in the middle of the night to ask for milk, the dog faithfully followed behind her.
